source.authority: Derived snapshot only; task files own dependency edges and QUEUE.md owns phases.

definitions.root_task: A task with no hard dependencies in the current roadmap graph.
definitions.terminal_task: A task with no direct dependents in the current roadmap graph.
definitions.dependency_component: A weakly connected group when edge direction is ignored.
definitions.large_dependency_branch: A task with at least 10 transitive dependents. This measures scheduling impact, not implementation scope or atomicity.
